Resolve a directory setting

Source: R/output.R
get_dir.Rd

Directory settings may refer to each other and to values known only when a scene renders, with {name} placeholders: the default video_dir is "{media_dir}/videos/{module_name}/{quality}". get_dir() fills them in, as upstream's config.get_dir(); quality is always known (for example "480p15"), other names come from ....

Usage

get_dir(key, ...)

Arguments

key

One of "assets_dir", "media_dir", "video_dir", "sections_dir", "images_dir", "text_dir", "tex_dir", "log_dir", "partial_movie_dir", "input_file" or "output_file".

...

Values for placeholders, such as module_name = "scenes" or scene_name = "Intro".

Value

The path, or NULL when the setting is empty.

Examples

get_dir("tex_dir")
#> [1] "/tmp/RtmpIvY9sz/media/Tex"
get_dir("video_dir", module_name = "scenes")
#> [1] "/tmp/RtmpIvY9sz/media/videos/scenes/1080p60"
